title: Policy Form Register: Part-Year Interest on Whole Life Insurance Accumulations Withdrawn at an Election
content:
The part of a year for which interest is credited on accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election of an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy follows the interest convention printed in the policy form, which the issue date sets:

| Policy form (issue date) | Part of a year credited |
|---|---|
| Before January 1, 1985 | Whole policy months from the start date to the date the election takes effect, over **12**; a remaining part month is not credited |
| January 1, 1985 through December 31, 2004 | Actual calendar days over **360** |
| On or after January 1, 2005 | Actual calendar days over **365** |

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

## Register example (hypothetical, interest from March 1, 2025 to September 1, 2025, 184 days)

| Issue date | Part of a year |
|---|---|
| 1982 | 6 whole months: 6 over 12 |
| 1999 | 184 over 360 |
| 2015 | 184 over 365 |

From March 1, 2025 to August 28, 2025 the count is 5 whole months on a pre-1985 form (the last part month is not credited), and 180 actual days on the later forms.
